title: Signal App: TradingView Alert Webhook + Rule Filter Layer
description:
**Problem:** Retail traders receive TradingView/Discord alerts but lack filtering discipline — too many noise alerts, no priority system, no quality gate.

**Solution:** Add a webhook ingestion layer to Signal App that accepts TradingView alerts, applies user-defined rule filters (signal source whitelist, volume gates, momentum thresholds, time-of-day gates), and only forwards high-signal-quality alerts to the trader. Freemium: 1 filter; Pro: unlimited custom filters + rule combinations.

**Revenue Model:** Extend Signal App freemium with Pro tier rules layer. Estimated: $5-15/mo per trader for rules features (target: 100-250 traders in Year 1 = $6k-45k MRR).

**Tech Fit:** Node.js webhook receiver, React rule builder, TradingView API integration — standard tech stack, solo-buildable, quick MVP (5-7 days).

**Why Joe Wins:**
- Extends existing Signal App (no new detection logic needed)
- Validates Signal App demand by solving a real user pain (noise reduction)
- Medium effort, proven synergy with current portfolio
- Freemium + Pro monetization pattern already validated in Signal App research
- Traders explicitly seek alert quality improvement (Reddit r/algotrading, TradingView forums)

**Market Evidence:**
- TradingView Discord webhook libraries are actively used (TradingView script library, GitHub fabston/TradingView-Webhook-Bot with 2.5k+ stars)
- r/TradingView (June 2022+): Active demand for Discord alert routing and filtering
- Scalping-Algo (Mar 2026): Full setup guides showing traders building custom alert filters
- Competing paid tools (Trademetria, TradeZella): Position alert filtering as Pro feature

**Recommendation:** Pursue as Signal App validation sprint after CoinUsUp trial unblock (P1 blocker clears). Ship MVP: (1) TradingView webhook receiver, (2) 3 basic rule types (source, price range, volume), (3) Pro tier pricing at $9.99/mo. Validates demand and builds foundation for advanced rules (AI sentiment filters, backtester integration, portfolio-aware gates).
